messages:
Priya B.: hey folks — quick q: where are the Notion docs for new hires? I can view the Engineer Onboarding pages but not edit the Week 1 templates. Who do I ping for edit access? :wave:

devex-bot: Hi! To request edit access to the Redwood Docs space, submit the access form at https://intranet/redwood/access or DM @Sam (DevEx). If you're in a rush, post the email you used to sign up and we'll add you.

Sam (DevEx): hey Priya, welcome! The main space is https://redwood.notion.so/Redwood-Docs-abc123 — what exact page are you trying to edit?

Priya B.: trying to edit: "Engineer Onboarding / Week 1 / Setup" — need to add notes about gcp creds and docker config.

Sam (DevEx): cool. can you reply with the email you used for Notion? we add editors by email. also include the page link if you can.

Priya B.: priya@redwood.com — page link: https://redwood.notion.so/Engineer-Onboarding-setup-xyz

Jordan (Eng): fyi — when you update templates, add a short changelog block at the top and tag the 'owner' property. We use the 'Onboarding Note' template for small how-tos (`Onboarding Note`).

Sam (DevEx): done — added priya@redwood.com as Editor on that page. can you try editing now?

Priya B.: I can edit now, thank you! Quick Q: what's the preferred naming convention for brand-new guides?

Emily - People Ops: hi — we prefer `YYYY-MM-topic` for top-level pages, e.g., `2026-03-gcp-creds`. Set the Page property 'Template' to 'Team guide' and add 'owner' to Eng.

Priya B.: great, I'll create the page and ping @Sam for a quick review. really appreciate the help :pray:
